name.ja: BB戦士331 武田信玄頑駄無

description.ja: 武者列伝のキャラが戦国武将コラボレーション！「SD戦国伝 武神降臨編」より甲斐の虎“武田信玄頑駄無”いざ出陣！！ 信玄のシンボルである赤い鎧と鬼面の兜に加え、風林火山と刻まれた軍配が付属 鎧は着脱可能、鎧だけを組み合わせて飾ることも可能 刀、薙刀、鉄砲のなどの武器と足軽兵が付属
description.en: Characters from Musha Retsuden collaborate with Sengoku military commanders! From "SD Sengokuden: Advent of the God of War ", the tiger of Kai " Takeda Shingen Gundam u" is ready for battle! ! In addition to Shingen's symbol red armor and demon-faced helmet, a military guard with Fuurinkazan engraved on it is included.The armor is removable, and you can also display it by combining just the armor.Weapons such as a sword, naginata, and gun, as well as ashigaru soldiers are included.
